purpose: Freeze exactly one source-backed correction after a read-only forensic audit of the Phase135 affine catastrophic-error boundary.

phase135_affine_implementation.role: historical Phase135 affine implementation pin; exact source hashes are listed in the audit

phase135_doppler_correction.role: historical Phase135 Doppler source-parity correction; not changed by Phase138

read_only_audit.numeric_residual_limit_reason: Sealed Phase136/137 records contain aggregate structural/accuracy metadata but no factor rows, per-family initial residuals, or Jacobian norms.

decision.selection_reason: Phase135 affine factors subtract the prepared carrier delta as if it were the official residual delta. Official Gobs/TDCP includes the fixed initial geometric-range difference; adding only that constant is a separable correction while preserving Phase118 atmosphere handling.
not_selected: ECEF/ENU los-transpose or Pose3/PX bridge correction: source and native rigid transform are algebraically consistent.
C7/D unit or sign correction: source-meter C7 and metre-per-second D conventions are consistent.
full official resL atmosphere replacement: separate Phase120 compound and not silently combined here.
post-stage P/base re-materialization: source-backed but compound and not a single measurement constant.
IMU/bias topology or velocity synthesis: separate topology/init change; no unapproved finite-difference or zero fallback.

measurement_contract.existing_input: tdcp_native_i = m_{i+1}-m_i, where m is the already frozen Phase118 prepared carrier/clock/atmosphere measurement
measurement_contract.rho_definition: source geometric range at the exact affine initial endpoint, with the source satellite state and exactly one Sagnac convention also used by the affine LOS
measurement_contract.official_relation: official resL_{i+1}-resL_i contains (z_{i+1}-z_i)-(rho_{i+1}-rho_i)+(d_{i+1}-d_i); the selected adapter ports only the missing geometric constant into the frozen native measurement
measurement_contract.atmosphere_policy: Phase118 corrected-carrier atmosphere convention remains unchanged; full official resL substitution is not included

fixed.pairing_and_gates: existing same-signal adjacent pair, loss-of-lock, clock, gap, code-phase, finite, and admission predicates
fixed.factor_count: ordinary TDCP admitted count unchanged; no legacy/affine mixing
fixed.c7_clock_state: seven metre-valued components and existing component mapping unchanged
fixed.d_clock_drift_state: metre-per-second D state and existing sign unchanged
fixed.ccdd: existing CCDD equation and sigma unchanged
fixed.coordinate_bridge: ENU/ECEF rotation, Pose3/PX bridge, and zero Pixel5 lever-arm convention unchanged
fixed.sagnac: one source-consistent range/LOS convention, no second correction
fixed.qr_lm_imu_filter: Phase118/135 QR, LM schedule, IMU, filter, and topology unchanged
fixed.raw_base: existing Phase107 raw-base correction exactly once
fixed.pixel5_output_offset: existing final output offset exactly once
fixed.other_phase_selectors: Phase117/120/additional-frequency and Phase126-134 compound selectors remain as the pinned recipe specifies

fail_closed: missing or nonfinite source range endpoint
source endpoint key, satellite state, epoch, or Sagnac convention mismatch
nonfinite prepared TDCP or range difference
attempted fallback to raw carrier, zero, held, inferred, saved-solution, nearest, or extrapolated range
attempted mixed legacy and Phase135 affine TDCP family
factor count or retained pair ledger mismatch
candidate.selector_off_invariant: Phase135-disabled and Phase138-disabled behavior is byte/semantic identical to the pinned legacy/Phase135 implementation.

coordinate_and_unit_invariants.native_main_auxiliary_state: local ENU X with Pose3 translation bridged to ECEF
coordinate_and_unit_invariants.clock_export: divide metre clock by speed of light exactly once
coordinate_and_unit_invariants.pixel5_offset: official -0.10 m right-left and -0.30 m up-down, native final-output application once

sealed_structural_facts.interpretation: sealed finite/progress/cost/count facts only; no claim that the measurement semantic is accurate

sealed_accuracy_facts.promotion_gate: not evaluated or promoted by Phase138; sealed historical strict macro < 0.782 m was not met

implementation_tests_required: synthetic two-epoch identity: affine initial residual after subtracting delta rho equals the legacy first-order residual under identical source geometry
official Gobs residual-difference algebra and sign/unit test
source geodist/Sagnac endpoint-key and finiteness test
ENU/ECEF origin and rotation invariance, PX bridge, C7/D dimension tests
pair/factor/ledger conservation and atomic no-mix/fail-closed tests
selector-off byte/semantic regression with fixed sigma 0.03 m, Huber k 0.5, QR/LM, raw-base, and Pixel5 offset invariants

raw_inputs_allowed_only_after_authorizat: sealed raw base if the pinned recipe requires it
